Ingrid_Cust: Hi team — invoice INV-2026-0891 is on hold for VAT. Our EU billing needs reverse charge; VIES lookup shows invalid when we run it. VAT: DE123456789.
Oliver_Support: Thanks Ingrid. Can you attach any resale/zero-rate certificate and the company registry extract? Also, did you intend to bill to the parent entity or the local subsidiary?
Ingrid_Cust: Attaching two files: https://files.redwood/ingrid/resale_cert_parent.pdf and https://files.redwood/ingrid/registry_extract_parent.pdf — parent should be billed, PO PO-8891 included.
Maria_Billing: Got the uploads. Quick note: our automated flow requires either a VIES PASS or (resale cert + registry + signed liability acceptance). If VIES fails we kick to manual tax review.
Raj_Tax: I'll run our internal checks now. Repro for auditors:
```bash
# internal vies check
curl -s "https://internal-tools.redwood/vies?vat=DE123456789" | jq .
# national registry fallback
curl -s "https://de-registry.example/lookup?vat=DE123456789"
```
tax-bot: VIES: INVALID (reason: "structure unknown"); checked 2026-06-08T10:12Z. National registry lookup: FOUND — Parent AG, Berlin, registered 2010-04-12.
Raj_Tax: Registry matches the PDF name. We still need a short signed cover note from the parent confirming they accept liability for invoices and VAT treatment when billed on behalf of subsidiaries. Can the customer upload that?
Ingrid_Cust: Uploaded parent-liability-note.pdf (signed). Also confirming the resale cert explicitly covers software/subscription services.
Maria_Billing: Thanks — please confirm language. If not English we'll accept German but need the key fields highlighted: VAT number, issuer, legal name.
Ingrid_Cust: It's German; highlighted fields included.
Sophie_Finance: FYI — we can clear the hold after tax approval but operations must record a manual override and attach all documents to the invoice record. If reverse charge applies we issue a corrected invoice (zero VAT) and issue a credit for the original with notes.
Raj_Tax: Everything present: resale cert, registry extract, signed liability note, PO. Approving reverse charge for INV-2026-0891. Document the decision: reverse charge approved under Art. 196 EU and local regs.
Maria_Billing: Noted. Proceeding to billing with manual override. I'll update ledger entries and create corrected invoice INV-2026-0891-RC and credit CR-2026-045. Expect emails to the billing contact in 1-2 business days.
Oliver_Support: @Ingrid_Cust we've cleared the hold and emailed the updated invoice and credit notes. Sorry for the extra steps and thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
Ingrid_Cust: Thanks all. One request — can you publish a one-page checklist for group-billing cases so customers can submit all docs in one go? Saves time.
Maria_Billing: Good idea. We'll add a KB checklist: required = VIES pass OR (resale cert PDF + registry extract + signed liability note + PO). Will link back to support tickets when ready.
Oliver_Support: Closing thread. If anything reappears please reopen or ping #support. :white_check_mark:
